component.name: iProjection (Unofficial)
component.summary: Control and cast to Epson projectors from Linux

description.p: iProjection (Unofficial) (linux-iprojection) is a native Linux application built by John Varghese (J0X) to control and cast to Epson projectors seamlessly via the ESC/VP.net and EShare protocols.
Enterprise resilience, projector authentication keyword support, and multi-resolution casting.

ul.li: Added ESC/VP.net challenge-response authentication for connection passwords and 4-digit keywords.
Interactive connection authentication dialog in UI with persistent device credential storage.
Added configurable casting resolutions (1080p, 720p, WXGA 1280x800, XGA 1024x768) and custom framerates.
Optimized RTP/UDP socket buffering (512KB) and MTU (1400) to eliminate packet loss over Wi-Fi/VLANs.
Multi-subnet Wake-on-LAN broadcast across ports 7 and 9 with direct MAC parsing.
EEMP dual-port discovery fallback to prevent bind conflicts.
Fixed protocol stream unread buffering and event loop synchronization.

description.p: Enterprise error reporting and bug fixes.

ul.li: Fixed GStreamer caps negotiation for VA-API and NVENC hardware encoders.
Bounded screen capture resolution to 1080p to fit projector hardware limits.
Fixed crash on start (log_writer TypeError) affecting some distros.
Added automated crash reporting with one-click GitHub issue generation.
